dob.title: Aapki date of birth
dob.subtitle: Sitara adults ke liye hai — hum sirf ek baar, sign-up par check karte hain.
dob.label: Date of birth

auth.underage: Sitara 18 saal aur usse bade logon ke liye hai, isliye yeh account nahin ban sakta. Aapki sachchai ke liye shukriya.
auth.dob_required: Account banane ke liye apni date of birth batayein.
auth.invalid_phone: Yeh phone number sahi nahin lag raha. Check karke dobara koshish karein.
auth.invalid_token: Sign-in poora nahin ho paya. Dobara koshish karein.
auth.session_expired: Aapka session khatam ho gaya hai. Dobara sign in karein.
auth.otp_throttled: Bahut baar koshish ho chuki hai. 15 minute ruk kar dobara try karein.
auth.provider_conflict: Yeh sign-in tareeka pehle se kisi aur account se juda hai.
auth.link_offer: In details ke saath aapka Sitara account pehle se hai. Apne purane tareeke se sign in karein, phir Settings se isse link karein.
auth.apple_unavailable: Apple sign-in abhi available nahin hai — phone ya Google use karein.
auth.step_up_required: Aapki suraksha ke liye, link karne se pehle apni pehchaan verify karein.
auth.no_pending_conflict: Abhi kuch resolve karne ke liye nahin hai.

astro.insufficient_birth_data: Ise sahi se calculate karne ke liye mere paas poori jaankari nahin hai — kya hum ise poora kar lein?
astro.place_unresolved: Us janm sthaan ka time zone confirm nahin ho paya. Jagah ki details check karke dobara koshish karein.
astro.engine_unavailable: Calculation seva abhi thodi der ke liye available nahin hai. Thodi der mein dobara try karein.
astro.provider_disputed: Hamare sources is detail par abhi poori tarah sehmat nahin hain, isliye hum guess karne ki bajaye dobara jaanch rahe hain.
astro.name_unconfirmed: Aapke ank nikalne se pehle apne naam ki spelling confirm karein.
astro.name_invalid: Is naam mein aise characters hain jo hum naam ki tarah nahin padh pa rahe. Check karke dobara koshish karein.

sys.validation: Request mein kuch theek nahin tha. Dobara koshish karein.
sys.internal: Hamari taraf se kuch gadbad ho gayi. Thodi der mein dobara try karein.

transliteration.confirm: Humne aapka naam ‘{name}’ padha — sahi hai?
